content.text: NPCs wearing helmets, masks or hoods sound muffled like the player. These settings only affect NPCs.

content.help: Muffle the voices of nearby NPCs that wear a helmet, mask or hood. Default: ON
NPCs further away than this are not checked. Default: 36
How often nearby NPCs are checked. Lower values react sooner but cost more script time. Default: 1.0

content.text: Check all armor slots of NPCs
content.help: By default only the head and face slots (30-32 and 46-50, 52) of NPCs are checked. Turn this on if a mod puts a muffling item in another slot. Costs more script time. Default: OFF
